lines.text: Catch you later, I have to go!

example.text: Catch you later, I have to go!

misuse.text: Don't end a formal interview with 'catch you later'.
misuse.why: It's too casual for formal talks.

publish.title: What does "catch you later" mean?
publish.value: Catch you later = See you later. Example: "Catch you later, I have to go!" (casual English, US).
